description: Splits the sale proceeds between one preferred class and common holders for a liquidation multiple and participation clause (non-participating, participating uncapped, participating capped at 3x). Returns the conversion point, a sensitivity table and the three standard structures side by side. Same math as https://modevc.com/tools/term-sheet-waterfall. Illustrative model: one preferred class, no seniority stack, no debt or fees.

exit_valuation.description: Sale price in USD. Web default 45,000,000.
exit_valuation.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

preferred_invested.description: Total invested by the preferred class in USD. Web default 12,000,000.
preferred_invested.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

preferred_ownership_pct.description: As-converted ownership of the preferred class, in percent (1 to 95). Web default 30.
preferred_ownership_pct.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

pro_rata_current_pct.description: Your current ownership for the pro-rata check, in percent. Web default 10.
pro_rata_current_pct.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

pro_rata_next_round_size.description: Next round size in USD for the pro-rata check. Web default 15,000,000.
pro_rata_next_round_size.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default
